Streaming JPEG encoder attribution

CXO FilmPack's StreamingJpegWriter is a Kotlin streaming adaptation of the
encoder in jpeg-js, lib/encoder.js, pinned to commit:
1031ccd7a63c641c16afb2430279d1598530a85c
https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js/blob/1031ccd7a63c641c16afb2430279d1598530a85c/lib/encoder.js

The source identifies its JavaScript port/optimization as Andreas Ritter,
www.bytestrom.eu, November 2009. That encoder derives from Adobe's encoder.
The preserved Adobe BSD-3-Clause notice follows. Changes for this project:
Kotlin/JVM adaptation; eight-row input callback; direct OutputStream output;
minimal EXIF orientation segment; algebraic category/bit representation in
place of the large lookup table. Original AAN DCT, standard quantization,
YCbCr conversion and standard Huffman tables are retained.
